==English== ===Etymology=== From {{uder|en|la|relapsus}}, past participle of {{m|la|relabi||to slide back, fall back}}, from {{m|la|re-||back}} + {{m|la|labi||to slip, slide, fall}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈlæps/|/ˈɹiːˌlæps/}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-relapse1.wav|a=Southern England}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-relapse2.wav|a=Southern England}} * {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vininn126-relapse.wav|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|æps|s=2}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[fall]] [[back]] again; to slide or turn back into a former state or practice. #: {{ux|en|He has improved recently but keeps '''relapsing''' into states of utter confusion.}} #: {{ux|en|to '''relapse''' into a stupor, into vice, or into barbarism}} #: {{ux|en|to '''relapse''' into slumber after being disturbed}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=Then we '''relapsed''' into a discomfited silence, and wished we were anywhere else. But Miss Thorn relieved the situation by laughing aloud, and with such a hearty enjoyment that instead of getting angry and more mortified we began to laugh ourselves, and instantly felt better.}} # {{lb|en|intransitive|medicine|of a disease}} To [[recur]]; to [[worsen]], [[be]] [[aggravate]]d {{gloss|after a period of improvement}}. # {{lb|en|intransitive|informal|specifically}} To [[return]] to a [[vice]], especially [[self-harm]] or [[alcoholism]], failing to maintain [[abstinence]]. #: {{ux|en|'''relapsed''' after 5 months of being clean}} # To slip or slide back physically; to [[turn back]]. #* {{RQ:Dryden Fables|The Hind and the Panther|passage=You slip your hold and change your side,
'''Relapsing''' from a necessary guide.}} ====Hyponyms==== * {{sense|to fall back into a former state or practice}} [[fall off the wagon]] ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|irrelapsable|relapsable|relapser|nonrelapsed|nonrelapsing|unrelapsing|relapsing fever}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top-see|To fall back again|rebound|lapse}} * Catalan: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Hungarian: * Interlingua: * Italian: * Macedonian: * Portuguese: * Quechua: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|впадать}} * Scottish Gaelic: * Spanish: * Swedish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|(medicine) To recur; to worsen}} * Bikol: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Cebuano: * Dutch: * Finnish: * German: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Italian: * Japanese: * Macedonian: * Manx: * Māori: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|обостряться}}, {{t+|ru|рецидивировать}} * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: {{trans-bottom}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # The act or situation of relapsing. #: {{ux|en|a drug '''relapse'''}} #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Regained|book=2|passage=Alas! from what high hope to what '''relapse''' / Unlooked for are we fallen!}} # {{lb|en|medicine}} An occasion when a person becomes ill again after a period of improvement # {{lb|en|obsolete}} One who has relapsed, or fallen back into [[error]]; a [[backslider]]. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|irrelapsable|nonrelapse|prerelapse|relapsable|relapser }} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|the act or situation of relapsing}} * Bikol: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Cebuano: * Choctaw: * Czech: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Hungarian: * Interlingua: * Italian: * Macedonian: * Manx: * Māori: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|рециди́в|m}} * Scottish Gaelic: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} ===See also=== * {{l|en|remission}} ===Further reading=== * {{R:Webster 1913}} * {{R:Century}} * {{R:OneLook}} ===Anagrams=== * {{anagrams|en|a=aeelprs|Leapers|Perales|leapers|pleaser|presale|repeals}}
